description:
Use this when you need expense data. Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the official GSA CONUS lodging and M&IE ceiling for one US ZIP or city on one date, plus the official IRS standard mileage rate in effect that day. CONUS only. MCP: get_expense_data(kind="intuitive", zip="20001", date="2026-11-22"). Official GSA CONUS per diem and official IRS standard mileage rates.
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the official GSA CONUS rate plus the official M&IE meal breakdown, first-and-last-day M&IE, the locality's seasonal table and other specified destinations in the same state. MCP: get_expense_data(kind="stats", city="Miami", state="FL", date="2026-12-15"). Official GSA CONUS per diem and official IRS standard mileage rates.
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Use this when an agent needs an official multi-day CONUS trip estimate (lodging nights plus 75% M&IE on the first and last travel days, per the Federal Travel Regulation), an optional second-locality comparison, or an official IRS mileage multiplication (?miles=). MCP: get_expense_data(kind="pro", zip="33101", date="2026-12-01", end_date="2026-12-04").
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Use this when an agent needs official-rate flags: standard CONUS applies, high-cost locality (lodging at least 1.5 times standard CONUS), or a seasonal peak or low for that locality. Flags are comparisons of published ceilings, not travel advice. MCP: get_expense_data(kind="signals", city="San Francisco", state="CA").
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
